formal.consequent: foreach (int i = 0; i < top_pkg::TL_DBW; i++) combined_data[8*i +: 8] == (held_data.a_mask[i] ? held_data.a_data[8*i +: 8] : rsp_data[8*i +: 8])

assumptions.claim: held_data.a_mask, held_data.a_data, rsp_data, and combined_data must have widths at least TL_DBW*8 to match the loop indexing
assumptions.risk: If any signal is narrower than required, out-of-range indexing may read X or drive wrong slices, corrupting the merged write data

formal.consequent: (held_data.a_mask width >= top_pkg::TL_DBW) && (held_data.a_data width >= top_pkg::TL_DBW*8) && (rsp_data width >= top_pkg::TL_DBW*8) && (combined_data width >= top_pkg::TL_DBW*8)

uncertain_points.risk: Byte‑lane selection could read invalid bits or drive X into combined_data, leading to SRAM data corruption or functional failure
